run_train_representation_main: run the main training loop for R3M representation learning on the ego4d dataset using hydra config
create_workspace: create a Workspace instance that sets up dataloaders, initializes the model, and prepares the training environment
run_workspace_train: run the Workspace train method to execute the training loop with periodic evaluation and snapshot saving
create_make_network: create a DataParallel model from a hydra config and move it to the GPU for training
review_workspace_save_snapshot: review the Workspace save_snapshot method that persists the model state dict and global step to disk
